impact: A sixth straight S&P loss below the 200-day puts all AI holdings (MU, DRAM, SNXX, NBIS, GOOGL, MSFT, PLTR) at risk of further de-risking, and suggests ANT is pulling money from existing AI names.
summary: The early tech rally reversed into a broad selloff on Thursday. The Dow fell 1,101.11 points (2.19%) to 49,097.06, the S&P 500 dropped 2.02% to 7,175.83, its sixth straight loss and further below its 200-day average, and the Nasdaq lost 2.25% to 23,879.20. CNBC said Anthropic's record IPO, which opened at $111.50 and then faded, failed to revive the AI trade as investors took profits.
title: Dow sinks 1,101 points below 50,000; Nasdaq -2.25% as Anthropic fails to lift AI trade
